new: Swati has a wooden cube of edge 13 cm. She makes three flat cuts, as shown by the dashed lines, each 10 cm from the same corner along an edge, so the cube splits into 8 blocks. Two of the blocks are cubes. What is the total volume of the other six blocks?
why: 'a corner' lets each cut be measured from a different corner; the answer needs the same corner. 'Straight cut' of a solid is a plane cut.

old: In lowest terms, a fraction terminates only if its denominator has no prime factor other than 2 and 5. 14/45 is in lowest terms and 45 = 3² × 5, so it recurs (0.3111…); the others reduce to 3/8, 9/50 and 13/64, which terminate.
new: 27/150 = 9/50 = 0.18, 13/64 = 0.203125 and 21/56 = 3/8 = 0.375 all terminate: each can be written over a power of 10. Dividing, 14/45 = 0.3111…, which recurs.
why: The 'denominator has only 2 and 5' test is the C10 decimal-expansion theorem (brief: stays C10); use division instead.
